title: Opus FEC-aware scheduling

definition.title: Opus FEC-aware scheduling
definition.source_excerpt: A 48 kHz mono Opus stream used 20 ms packets with in-band FEC enabled. Packet 60 was treated as lost. Immediate PLC added no wait but produced −6.55 dB SNR for the lost frame. Waiting exactly one subsequent packet (20 ms) and requesting its in-band FEC improved that lost frame to +8.11 dB. The FEC result was still not exact. A modeled retransmission/rebuffer path that receives the original packet after 60 ms is exact by construction. This supports an explicit scheduling policy: FEC can buy materially better concealment for one bounded packet of latency, while exactness still requires original coded data. Network retransmission timing was modeled here, not measured from a real transport.
